header: Everything a shift plan touches, in one system
lead: Rotas, hours, absence and the payroll file live together, so the branch manager and the head office are never looking at two different versions of the same week.

items.title: Rota building
items.text: Drag a shift into place and the contract hours, the rest period and the branch budget are all checked before you let go of it.

items.title: Clock-in that holds up
items.text: Staff clock in at the branch tablet or on their own phone inside a geofence, and every later correction keeps its trail.

items.title: Absence in one queue
items.text: Holiday, sick leave and unpaid days arrive in the same approval list, with the cover gap shown beside each request.

items.title: Costed before it is published
items.text: Every draft week shows its wage cost against the branch budget, so an overspend is a decision somebody made rather than a surprise.

items.title: Payroll in one file
items.text: The month closes into the format your payroll bureau already accepts, with approved corrections applied.

items.title: Every branch on one screen
items.text: Area managers compare all their sites at once and move a shift between two of them without a phone call.
